parole.testo: Borrowed from Ancient Greek ἄλφα (álpha), of Semitic origin. First attested in the 14th century.

parole.significato: hyssop (any of several aromatic bushy herbs, of the genus Hyssopus)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Czech yzop. Derived from Ancient Greek ὕσσωπος (hússōpos), of Semitic origin. First attested in the 14th century.
